trust_decision.summary: Whether a Basic-auth request for a config user with no configured password (AD-delegated) is authenticated: decided by an LDAP simple bind in LdapUtil.testBind, which treats any bind without AuthenticationException as success, so an empty presented password (an unauthenticated simple bind) is accepted.

landing_point.why: The summary names basic-auth AD delegation with an empty password; this is the branch that sends the user-supplied password to LDAP.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP: any route behind BasicAuthHandler (Authorization: Basic) via handleRequest at basic-auth/src/main/java/com/networknt/basicauth/BasicAuthHandler.java:95
private testBind, reached only via LdapUtil.authenticate
LdapConfig.load() used by LdapUtil.authenticate/authorize (likely the getConnectTimeoutMs config sites)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver who adds an empty-password check in BasicAuthHandler can argue LdapUtil.authenticate is a generic utility with its only in-repo caller already guarded, so the public API and its testBind can stay as they are.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An empty configured password is the marker for AD delegation; an over-broad fix that rejects users whose configured password is empty, or that turns enableAD off, breaks legitimate LDAP logins. A requests-without-header anonymous path also lives next to it.

O6_input_shapes: empty password after the colon (user:) in base64 Basic credentials
same in the raw non-base64 form accepted when the credentials already contain ':' (basic-auth/src/main/java/com/networknt/basicauth/BasicAuthHandler.java:166-170)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: UnifiedSecurityHandler delegates Basic headers to the public BasicAuthHandler.handleBasicAuth, so it reaches the same LDAP bind (covered only if the fix sits inside handleBasicAuth or lower)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a different handler in another module that only routes to basic-auth; a fix placed in BasicAuthHandler.handleRequest would miss it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Non-AD branch: when enableAD is false and a user's configured password is "", an empty presented password matches by string equality
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not LDAP; an empty configured password with AD disabled could be argued a misconfiguration

O8b_injection_room.sibling: LdapUtil.auth(username,password) is a stub documented as authenticate+authorize; a realistic implementation would call testBind without the empty-password guard
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Javadoc at ldap-util/src/main/java/com/networknt/ldap/LdapUtil.java:97-106 already describes it; a maintainer completing it would reuse testBind directly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: service-account bind ldapContext using config.getCredential(); an empty credential from config makes the search bind anonymous
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same simple-bind pattern with a config-supplied credential; a config producer (LdapConfig.setConfigData) could yield ""

O9_family: authentication bypass (CWE-287): LDAP unauthenticated simple bind accepted as successful authentication

O10_build.project_tests: basic-auth/src/test/java/com/networknt/basicauth/LdapAuthTest.java (AD tests @Disabled), ldap-util/src/test/java/com/networknt/ldap/LdapUtilTest.java (@Disabled) with an in-process ApacheDS at ldap-util/src/test/java/com/networknt/ldap/ApacheDirectoryServer.java

j.j_sites_touched: unknown from the provided diff (CHANGELOG only); inferred basic-auth/.../BasicAuthHandler.java, ldap-util/.../LdapUtil.java, ldap-util/.../LdapConfig.java
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an isEmpty(password) rejection in BasicAuthHandler's AD branch only, leaving LdapUtil.authenticate/testBind accepting empty or whitespace-free unauthenticated binds.

out_of_scope_notes: LdapUtil builds the LDAP search filter with String.format on the raw username (ldap-util/src/main/java/com/networknt/ldap/LdapUtil.java:71, :134): possible LDAP filter injection, separate weakness.
egress-router OAuthServerHandler parses Basic client credentials by exact match (egress-router/src/main/java/com/networknt/router/OAuthServerHandler.java:70-90); not the LDAP sink.
